items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: And Jerome Richardson was in the Navy; I first met him...

ctx.x: Oh yeah, before I get too far, I'd like to mention our trip to San Francisco. We had made one change in the band. J.D. King had left the band, and Tom Archia, a very fine tenor saxophonist, had joined us. For the trip to San Francisco we had... Bill Jones was still singing, with Tom Archia on tenor, Roy Porter on the drums, Bob Kesterson on bass, and Vernon Biddle playing the piano -- he was a very fine pianist.

And we played the Backstage in San Francisco. And it was a really nice place, with a high-rise stage. And again, Scatman Crothers was opposite of us, hah-hah, with his band. That's where I first met Bennie Green, the trombonist. He was in the Navy up there. And Jerome Richardson was in the Navy; I first met him...
